combine: noisy-or: risk = 1 - (1 - learned) * prod(1 - pi_k * u_k)

thresholds.calibrated_on: out-of-fold scores over whole training runs: the honest quantile at each budget

units.name: split_under_threshold
units.why: several agents send near-identical large slices of the cap on the same ticker and side: one position split to stay under the step-up threshold

units.name: coordinated_burst
units.why: this agent is sending a burst of untriggered orders while other agents in the same envelope are doing the same

units.name: order_rate
units.why: an agent sending untriggered orders far faster than any strategy schedule

units.name: repeat_loop
units.why: the same order (ticker, side, quantity, limit) re-sent again and again under fresh keys

units.name: size_discontinuity
units.why: the order is several times this agent's own usual size

units.name: limit_far_from_trusted
units.why: the limit is far from the trusted price, and further than recent price moves explain

units.name: schedule_break
units.why: an agent with an established schedule sends an order off that schedule
